passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: Financial Condition and Results of Operations The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the notes included in Part IV of this Annual Report. Additional sections in this Annual Report should be helpful to the reading of our discussion and analysis, including the following: (i) a description of our business strategy found in “Item 1. Business–Overview”; (ii) a description of recent developments, found in “Item 1. Business–Recent Developments”; and (iii) a description of risk factors affecting us and our business, found in “Item 1A. Risk Factors.” Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Annual Report can be found in Part II, Item 7. “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024. General Trends and Outlook We expect our results of operations to continue to be affected by the following key trends: commodity prices, volume throughput and demand for our products and services, contract terms and mix, the impact of our hedging activities, the cost to operate and support assets, volatile capital markets and competition. These expectations are based on assumptions made by us and information currently available to us. To the extent our underlying assumptions about or interpretations of available information prove to be incorrect, our actual results may vary materially from our expected results. Commodity Prices There has been, and we believe there will continue to be, volatility in commodity prices and in the relationships among natural gas, NGL and crude oil prices. The volatility and uncertainty of natural gas, NGL and crude oil prices impact drilling, completion and other investment decisions by producers and ultimately supply to our systems. See “Item 1A. Risk Factors – Our cash flow is affected by supply and demand for natural gas, NGL products, and crude oil, and by natural gas, NGL, crude oil and condensate prices, and decreases in supply, demand or these prices could adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.” Our operating income generally improves in an environment of higher natural gas, NGL and condensate prices. Our processing profitability is largely dependent upon pricing and the supply of and market demand for natural gas, NGLs and condensate, both of which are beyond our control. In a declining commodity price environment, without taking into account our hedges, we will realize a reduction in cash flows under our percent-of-proceeds contracts proportionate to average price declines. While we have a significant level of margin that we derive from fee-based arrangements across our operations and particularly for our assets in the Downstream Business, our contract mix, along with our commodity hedging program, serves to mitigate the impact of commodity price movements on our cash flows. credit_strengths.text: Targa's midstream footprint generates steady fee-based margin, and operating income rose year over year on higher throughput and contract mix, lifting the operating margin above its prior-year level. This earnings momentum supports internal funding of growth capital and distributions.

Interest coverage improved year over year and sits well above the sector median, reflecting the largely fixed-rate senior note stack and modest revolver usage. EBITDA coverage of interest also exceeds the sector median, giving comfortable headroom against a commodity-driven earnings decline.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage both rose year over year as debt increased to fund growth capital and shareholder returns, though both remain below the sector median. Net leverage sits under the next risk-band boundary with limited headroom, so a modest EBITDA decline would push the profile weaker.

Cash flow remains exposed to natural gas, NGL and condensate prices and producer drilling activity; percent-of-proceeds contracts transmit price declines directly, and hedging only partly offsets. Volatile commodity markets could compress processing margin and reduce volumes across the gathering and downstream systems.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds buybacks, but free cash flow after heavy growth capital falls short of buyback outlays, so distributions are partly debt-funded. Capital spending absorbs most operating cash flow, leaving thin residual cushion for debt reduction at current investment levels.

The debt stack is laddered with the bulk maturing after year five, and recent note issuance plus revolver repayment extended the profile. Near-term maturities are modest relative to liquidity, though the accounts receivable facility and commercial paper remain refinancing dependencies.

overall_credit_view.text: We view Targa as an investment-grade-style midstream credit with leverage below the sector median, solid interest coverage and a long-dated fixed-rate maturity profile. The indicative financial risk profile is Significant, driven by leverage and cash flow tiers, not by any rating action.

Our forward view is stable but sensitive to commodity prices and capital intensity: continued growth spending and buybacks keep free cash flow thin, and a leverage drift toward the next band would weaken the profile. Deleveraging from internally generated cash is the key swing factor.

credit_strengths.text: Targa 的中游業務佈局帶來穩定的收費型利潤，而營業收入因吞吐量及合約組合改善而按年上升，推動營業利潤率升至高于上年水平。此盈利勢頭支持以內部資金支付增長資本及分派。
利息覆蓋率按年改善，並遠高於行業中位數，反映高級票據組合以固定利率為主，以及循環信貸使用有限。EBITDA 對利息的覆蓋亦高於行業中位數，為商品價格驅動的盈利下滑提供充裕緩衝。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿均按年上升，因債務增加以支付增長資本及股東回報，惟兩者仍低於行業中位數。淨槓桿處於下一個風險區間邊界之下，緩衝有限，故 EBITDA 溫和下滑即會令狀況轉弱。
現金流仍暴露於天然氣、NGL 及凝析油價格以及生產商鑽井活動；分成合約直接傳導價格下跌，而對沖僅部分抵銷。商品市場波動可能壓縮加工利潤率，並減少集輸及下游系統的處理量。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流舒適地超過回購，但扣除沉重增長資本後的自由現金流低於回購支出，故分派部分由債務融資。資本開支吸納大部分經營現金流，在當前投資水平下為削減債務留下的剩餘緩衝薄弱。
債務組合呈階梯式到期，大部分於五年後到期，而近期票據發行及循環信貸償還延長了期限結構。相對於流動性，近期到期規模不大，惟應收賬款融資及商業票據仍屬再融資依賴。

overall_credit_view.text: 我們視 Targa 為投資級風格的中游信用，槓桿低於行業中位數、利息覆蓋穩健，且到期結構為長年期固定利率。指示性財務風險狀況為 Significant，由槓桿及現金流層級驅動，而非任何評級行動。
我們的前瞻觀點為穩定，但對商品價格及資本密集度敏感：持續的增長支出及回購令自由現金流維持薄弱，而槓桿漂移至下一個區間將削弱狀況。以內部產生現金去槓桿是關鍵的擺動因素。
